name: Tiller & Persinger 1994: left then right temporal lobe (15 min each)
summary: Fifteen minutes of a weak (1 uT) pulsed field mainly over the left temporal lobe, then fifteen minutes over the right: the comparison order of Tiller & Persinger 1994. They gave a hypnotizability test after each exposure and reported raised scores only when the right hemisphere came first, not in this order.
notes: The helmet had four solenoids along each temporal plane; each left-right pair was on for 0.5 s (2 s per cycle). The pattern was a train of sine waves of about 10 to 12 Hz with rising amplitude, 'presented for 0.6 sec. once every four sec. for a total of 15 min' (Tiller 1994 p.2 [158]). Each subject got 15 min per side. After each exposure the eye covers came off for the exit questionnaire and the Hypnosis Induction Profile; there was no test before the first exposure (p.3 [159]). This program plays a 0.6-s train (200 points of 3 ms) of an 11 Hz wave of rising amplitude, then a 4-s pause, for 15 min mainly on the left and 15 min mainly on the right. It is rebuilt from the description: the paper says only that its file was 'similar to' Fig. 1B of Richards 1993, so the 11 Hz and the shape of the rise are this project's choice. The other side plays at a tenth. The phases run back to back: pause between them for the test. persinger-tiller-1994-right-then-left is the other order. One left-right pair is on at a time (0.5 s each), and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. Field: about 10 mG (1 uT) within the temporal cortex of the stimulated side and about 1 mG (0.1 uT) on the other (p.2-3 [158-159]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. One lab, never repeated outside it. In Granqvist 2005 suggestibility traits, not the field, predicted the reports. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history, implanted devices or pregnancy; stop at once on fear, headache or distress.
setting: Blindfolded (the lab used halves of a ping-pong ball filled with cotton), seated in a quiet room lit only by a small red light. The original gave Spiegel's Hypnosis Induction Profile after each 15-min exposure, by an experimenter who did not know the hypothesis; there was no test before the first exposure.
schedule: One session of two 15-min exposures, with the test after each; at most once a week. Run both orders and a sham in blinded, counterbalanced order.
source: Tiller & Persinger 1994, Int J Neurosci 79:157 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7744557/ ; Healey, Persinger & Koren 1996, Int J Neurosci 87:201 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9003980/ ; Carniello 2020, PhD thesis, Laurentian University, p. 89 (230-point burst-firing file, 3-ms points) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/8c92763c-cd19-4a21-b242-3b572a28ce55 ; Collins 2014, MA thesis 'Investigating the Shiva', Laurentian University, p. 31 (289 points, 3 ms, 4000 ms) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/16d96136-680c-4afe-8044-f9137bd01afc ; Persinger, Hoang & Baker-Price 2009, Electromagn Biol Med 28:374 ('once every 3 s for about 0.7 s') https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20017628/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
